name: STEINS;GATE 0
source:
"This is the story of the 'future' that could not be saved." 

December, 2010 - Beta Worldline:

At the end of his journey through countless worldlines filled with untold sorrows and hardship, the protagonist, [url=https://vndb.org/c6498]Okabe Rintarou[/url], sinks into despair and abandons all efforts of saving "her".

As his friends grow concerned for his well-being, Okabe immerses himself in the lifestyle of a serious student in a desperate attempt to push past his guilt and grief.
 
He attends a college seminar for extra credit while still struggling with trauma, where he comes across two scientists who belonged to the same school and research team as "her".

After he publicly defends their work against skepticism during a presentation, Okabe is invited to be a test subject for a research project titled "Amadeus"— an experimental AI which uses digitized memories as artificial intelligence avatars, one containing none other than "her" memories. 

But little did he know that the project would soon draw him back into that very world of dark conspiracies he had strived to avoid.

The story is inspired by the "Epigraph Trilogy" light novels and other various drama CDs.
translation:
“这是一个无法拯救的‘未来’的故事。”

2010年12月——β世界线：

主角[url=https://vndb.org/c6498]冈部伦太郎[/url]经历了无数充满悲伤与苦难的世界线后陷入绝望，放弃了一切拯救“她”的努力。

朋友们担心他的状况，于是冈部拼命试图摆脱罪恶感与悲痛，沉浸在认真学生的生活方式中。

他为了获得额外学分参加大学研讨会，尽管仍在与创伤抗争，却在那里遇到了两名曾与“她”就读同一学校、参与同一研究团队的科学家。

冈部在演讲中公开为他们的研究辩护，反驳了质疑，因此受邀成为名为“Amadeus”的研究项目的测试对象——那是一种使用数字化记忆作为人工智能化身的实验性AI，其中一个化身承载着“她”的记忆。

然而他没有想到，这个项目很快就会把他重新拖回那片他拼命想要逃离的黑暗阴谋之中。

本作受“命运石之门外传三部曲”轻小说及其他广播剧CD启发。
